summary: Completed comprehensive testing of GOJUNIORS e-commerce website. All major features tested and working: homepage, navigation, products, user auth, cart, checkout, admin dashboard. Fixed one backend serialization issue during testing.

fixed_issues.issue: MongoDB ObjectId serialization error causing 500 status
fixed_issues.fix_applied: Updated order creation response to return plain JSON objects instead of MongoDB documents

minor_issues.issue: Element detachment during navigation between admin pages

passed_tests: Homepage loads with hero section and categories
Navigation menu with Urdu categories working
Products page with filtering and search
Product detail page with size/quantity controls
Checkout page with COD and Stripe options
Complete order flow (registration → cart → checkout → success)

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (all major features working, 1 minor navigation issue)
